432:t_001:22.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, everyone! Let's take this base and rescue $$セツコ$$!」

432:t_001:23.en:
$$レド$$
「And we'll free this planet from you!」

432:t_001:24.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now, don't get so worked up. Why don't we cool down a little?」

432:t_002:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the hell did you do?!」

432:t_002:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I've lowered your fighting spirit. It's an application of the $$次元転移砲$$ and the scorpion's poison.」

432:t_002:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It brings back memories, doesn't it, $$クロウ$$?」

432:t_002:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You just keep rubbing us the wrong way.」

432:t_002:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「So getting hit by that causes mental damage...!」

432:t_002:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We've come this far. We will not retreat! Each of you must push through the mental damage with your own willpower!」

432:t_002:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「I won't lose if this comes down to fighting spirit!」

432:t_002:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! We'll charge with hard work and guts!」

432:t_002:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack! Target the enemy commander, $$サルディアス$$!」

432:t_002:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「Will $n be all right on his own?」

432:t_002:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「He said he'd push himself as hard as he could, then claw his way back up.」

432:t_002:15.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We should learn from that positive attitude.」

432:t_002:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hold on, $$セツコ$$! We're coming to save you now!!」

432:t_002:18.en:
$$シン$$
「$$バルビエル$$! I won't let you do whatever you want with $$セツコ$$!」

432:t_003:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...I'd expect no less from people who made it through all those traps.」

432:t_003:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then we'll give you a very special present instead.」

432:t_004:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're chasing Miss $$スズネ$$, chasing $$セツコ$$... You're really greedy, $n.」

432:t_004:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Has $$バルビエル$$'s aura changed...?」

432:t_004:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is... even greater hatred than before...!」

432:t_004:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Heh heh... $$セツコ$$... The compatibility of $$スフィア$$s is meaningless...」

432:t_004:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Because thanks to you, I've been able to deepen my hatred even further.」

432:t_004:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So love and hatred are two sides of the same coin.」

432:t_004:11.en:
$$桂$$
「This guy... His feelings for $$セツコ$$...」

432:t_004:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't pry into my heart.」

432:t_004:13.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You fly into a rage when someone teases you about the woman you love... You're just like an adolescent boy.」

432:t_004:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't make me laugh. You're saying this feeling of mine... is love?」

432:t_004:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I just... want to kill $$セツコ$$ so badly I can't stand it!」

432:t_004:16.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「There's no point explaining the forms of love to a little boy. I'll give you something else.」

432:t_004:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You'll taste defeat!」

432:t_004:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Try it! If the likes of you can manage it!」

432:t_004:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Be careful! He's even tougher than before!」

432:t_004:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But once we defeat him, we can save $$セツコ$$!」

432:t_004:21.en:
$$シン$$
「$$バルビエル$$! I won't let you have $$セツコ$$!」

432:t_005:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Is that all you've got, $c?」

432:t_005:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He can back up his words.」

432:t_005:2.en:
$$スザク$$
「He's certainly even stronger than the last time we fought him...!」

432:t_005:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll make you regret your insolent talk about handing me defeat.」

432:t_005:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I see... I'll acknowledge your strength.」

432:t_005:5.en:
$n
「But we're not the ones whose job it is to finish you off.」

432:t_006:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Thank you, everyone. I'm sorry I made you worry.」

432:t_006:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$... Being at your side let me touch your heart, just a little.」

432:t_007:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ is losing its power...!?」

432:t_007:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「This is your chance, $$セツコ$$!」

432:t_008:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$... When I touched your heart, I was filled with a sorrow unlike anything I'd ever felt...」

432:t_009:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I... want to free you from your hatred...」

432:t_011:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Stop! Don't look at me with those eyes!!」

432:t_011:5.en:
$$シン$$
「But how did you escape from the base?」

432:t_012:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No one but me has the right to do as they please with her.」
